items.source: Escapes all curly brackets in the input string by adding a backslash before them
items.translation: 通过在每个花括号前添加反斜杠来转义输入字符串中的所有花括号。

items.source: Unescapes previously escaped curly brackets by removing the backslashes
items.translation: 通过移除反斜杠来取消转义之前被转义的花括号。
